description: This file defines functions related to computing the loss for object detection models, specifically based on YOLO architecture. It includes functions for calculating Intersection over Union (IoU) variants, building targets, and computing loss components for bounding box regression, objectness, and classification.

methods.name: bbox_iou(box1, box2, x1y1x2y2=True, GIoU=False, DIoU=False, CIoU=False, eps=1e-9)
methods.description: Calculates the Intersection over Union (IoU) or variants like GIoU, DIoU, CIoU between two bounding boxes.

methods.name: compute_loss(loss_layers, targets, device="cpu")
methods.description: Calculates the total loss for YOLO object detection layers, including box regression loss, objectness loss, and classification loss, based on predictions and targets.

methods.name: build_targets(p, targets, loss_layers, device="cpu")
methods.description: Constructs target tensors for bounding box regression, objectness, and class predictions for each YOLO layer based on the ground truth targets.
